text: Which prestige real estate agencies in Gold Coast are the market leaders for luxury off-the-plan developments, penthouses, and architectural project marketing?

result.keyword: Which prestige real estate agencies in Gold Coast are the market leaders for luxury off-the-plan developments, penthouses, and architectural project marketing?

items.markdown:
The market leaders for luxury off-the-plan developments, penthouses, and architectural project marketing on the Gold Coast are **Kollosche**, **Amir Prestige** , and **TOTAL Property Group** , backed by high-end specialists like **Lucy Cole Prestige** and **DP Project Marketing**.[[1]](https://www.totalpropertygroup.com.au/)[[2]](https://www.lucycole.com.au/)[[3]](https://www.amirprestige.com.au/)[[4]](https://kollosche.com.au/new-projects/)

### Leading Prestige Agencies & Their Specialities

- **Kollosche (New Projects):** Dominates high-end coastal strip developments (such as *COAST* on Garfield Terrace and *AMALI* in Main Beach), providing end-to-end developer solutions from site acquisition to trophy penthouse sales.[[1]](https://kollosche.com.au/new-projects/)[[2]](https://www.kollosche.com.au/projects/)
- **Amir Prestige:** Known for record-breaking luxury transactions and ultra-high-net-worth client networking, managing top-tier beachfront mansions and landmark prestige apartment sales (such as records on Hedges Avenue and Burleigh Heads).[[1]](https://www.amirprestige.com.au/)
- **TOTAL Property Group:** Led by Adrian Parsons, this specialist project marketing firm has over 25 years of experience handling major architectural residential lifestyle developments and premium vertical communities along the beachfront.[[1]](https://www.totalpropertygroup.com.au/)
- **Lucy Cole Prestige:** A boutique independent powerhouse operating for over 25 years, highly regarded for high-net-worth private client advisory in luxury residential waterfront homes and penthouses.[[1]](https://www.lucycole.com.au/)
- **DP Project Marketing:** Headed by Deborah Provost, highly experienced in elite vertical project marketing and consultancy for landmark coastal and high-rise developments.[[1]](https://dpprojectmarketing.com/)

If you are looking to **buy** or **market a specific development** , tell me whether you are a **developer seeking strategy** or a **buyer searching for a penthouse** , and I can provide more **targeted project recommendations**.
